verdicts.reason: A shrinks the headline into a cramped three-line stack only a few pixels tall and bunches logo, headline, the tiny 'Full review inside.', the tilted badge and the product into the left two-thirds, leaving the right third empty. The fine print and badge are barely readable at this size. B sets the headline on one large line that clearly leads and fills the banner left to right, so it fits the format much better. But 'Full review inside.' sits on top of the green circle's edge (an unwanted collision), the circle touches the top and bottom of the canvas, and the NEW VIDEO badge is wedged under the logo, which looks like an afterthought.
